manual.label: Record money received outside the checkout
manual.help: When on, a team member with the "record payments" permission can record money a customer sent outside the checkout — bKash or Nagad to the shop's number, a bank transfer, cash at the counter — against an order, with the transaction number and the amount confirmed. The order's amount due and the amount the rider collects go down by exactly that much, so the customer is never asked for it again. Never more than the amount due. Every record is in the audit log. Off: nobody can record money this way.

reasons.label: Money mismatch reasons
reasons.help: The words for each reason a money figure does not match: a payment, what the rider collected, or a line of the courier's payment statement. The reasons themselves are fixed (so reports can count them); only their words are yours. A mismatch is never shown without its reason.

mismatch.AMOUNT_DIFFERS: The payment service confirmed another amount
mismatch.CURRENCY_DIFFERS: The payment service confirmed another currency
mismatch.PAID_AFTER_CLOSE: Money came in after the payment was closed
mismatch.DUPLICATE_PAYMENT: Money came in for an order already paid in full
mismatch.ORDER_CLOSED: Money came in for a cancelled order
mismatch.OVER_COLLECTED: The rider collected more than was due
mismatch.SHORT_COLLECTED: The rider collected less than was due
mismatch.PAID_ORDER_COLLECTED: Money was collected from a customer who had already paid
mismatch.PARTIAL_DELIVERY: Partly delivered: some pieces came back
mismatch.CHARGE_PAID_RETURN: Returned, the customer paid the delivery charge
mismatch.UNKNOWN_PARCEL: The courier paid for a parcel we cannot find
mismatch.DOUBLE_LINE: The same parcel is on the statement twice
mismatch.DOUBLE_CHARGE: The courier's charge was taken twice
mismatch.CHARGE_DIFFERS: The courier's charge is not the expected one
mismatch.SHORT_PAID: The courier paid less than expected
mismatch.OVER_PAID: The courier paid more than expected
mismatch.RETURN_AS_DELIVERED: Marked delivered, but it came back with the charge paid
mismatch.NOT_COLLECTED: Paid for a parcel that was returned or not delivered
mismatch.MISSING: Delivered, but no statement has paid for it yet
